messages:
alex: heads-up: noticing SLO misses on eu-west gpu pool since 09:12. p99 gen latency doubled. think it's continuous batching pressure + admission stalls
maria: i'm oncall. seeing admission-controller queue grow and batch fill waiting for max_batch. tail requests blocked
sam: rolling change yesterday enforced stricter max_batch fill thresholds, could be related
lee: we set per-gpu max_batch_size 32 to improve throughput but it increases wait time for long-seq requests that never fill
jen: logs show admission-throttles spike, pool_token_backlog=8200, inflight_batches=245
ops-bot: incident created INC-1589: eu-west inference latency spike
alex: mitigation options: allow partial batches, drop min fill requirement, or bypass batching for low-latency routes
sam: can push runtime flag admission.allow_partial=true and admission.min_batch_fill_pct=0.25
maria: tradeoff: smaller batches => lower GPU efficiency, higher cost ~15%, but restores SLOs
lee: also consider routing >2k token requests to dedicated capacity or preempting them to avoid blocking short queries
jen: can we short-circuit specific customer routes by adding header x-rl-priority: low-latency
infra-bot: autoscaler suggestion: add 2 gpus to eu-west pool now, estimated provision 3m
alex: i'm going to apply allow_partial in eu-west and open a 10% canary
sam: applying patch now, will roll to 10 percent
sam: command:
``
kubectl patch configmap runtime -n production --patch 'data:{admission.allow_partial:true,admission.min_batch_fill_pct:0.25}'
```
maria: good. monitoring dashboards show p99 dropping after canary
lee: follow-up: we should add per-route max_wait_ms and per-pool min_fill_pct defaults to avoid this class of regression
jen: create follow-up ticket to add e2e perf test for long-seq workloads and upgrade gating
alex: ack. setting INC-1589 priority P1 and will keep it open until both canary and autoscale are stable :thumbsup:
